answer_2.quote: We evaluate the optimized models by reporting language-modeling perplexity (PPL) on the WikiText-2 test set and the C4 validation set. For zero-shot performance, we use the LM-Evaluation-Harness on six benchmarks: ARC-Challenge, ARC-Easy, PIQA, BoolQ, and WinoGrande. We also report inference throughput as the median tokens per second.
